Name: Kenneth's Lunch Time
Author: Kf29
Description:
[size=4][b]Gives your farmer lunch every day, right in the middle of work.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]I made this because I like the idea of the farmer stopping for a bit to eat rice and lunch before going back to the fields.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]It is a different lunch each day, with rice and water on the side. 28 different lunches in total, one for each day of the month, and it loops when the next month starts.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Lunch is available from 12pm to 1:59pm. Go outside during that time and it will be in your bag. If you miss it, you wait for the next day.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]If your bag is full, check the lost and found at the mayor's house.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Works on new or existing saves. Sleep one night after installing and it will start the next day.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]You will need Kenneth's Hearty Breakfast and Grill, Restaurant, and Drink Shop, plus SMAPI and Content Patcher.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Safe to add or remove anytime.[/b][/size]
